source_evidence: REITs provide a way for individual investors to earn a share of the income produced through commercial real estate ownership – without actually having to go out and buy commercial real estate.
question: How can investing in a REIT provide exposure to income-producing real estate without buying a property directly?
answer: A REIT owns and typically operates income-producing real estate or related assets. By investing in a REIT, individuals can earn a share of the income from commercial real estate ownership without purchasing the property themselves.
